summary: Iter 69 - Verified Partner Job Request page + full-screen Incoming Job Ring overlay (web-parity port) on Expo web (390x844). Backend: 5/5 core partner endpoints pass (auth/config expiry, /bookings/partner/jobs, /bookings/partner/ring-pending, PUT /auth/partner/online-status, POST /partner/test-ring). All requested testIDs present.
critical_code_review_comments: JobRingOverlay.tsx is a faithful 1:1 port of web IncomingJobRing.jsx: never auto-declines, SSE + 6s ring-pending poll fallback, distance/ETA via geolocation, DND/snooze aware, queue with 'more waiting' pill. Clean separation with useLoop/RingAvatar. Good use of testIDs on every interactive/informational element.

jobs.tsx correctly wires SSE job_taken -> instant card removal via qc.setQueryData, refetchInterval falls back to 10s when SSE disconnected. Countdown ring shows 'Expiring…' when past expiry (observed for older seed booking).
